normalizerRefusal: GeoJSON requires an RFC 7946 FeatureCollection in longitude/latitude EPSG:4326, without a crs override.
inspectionRefusal: Projected or unknown GeoJSON CRS overrides are unsupported; use a native GIS source with declared CRS.

runtimePlan.cb1: CB1 uses nonce tmpfs PostGIS plus in-memory HTTP object storage and Python pure-function HTTP stand-in; CR1 uses the actual FastAPI geo image instead.
commands: docker run --detach --pull never --name ulpin-cr1-geo-<nonce> --label io.ulpin.task=CR1 --label io.ulpin.nonce=<nonce> --publish 127.0.0.1::8000 --env GEO_SERVICE_TOKEN --env PROJ_NETWORK=OFF ulpin-cr1-geo:<nonce>

docker run --detach --pull never --name ulpin-cr1-db-<nonce> --label io.ulpin.task=CR1 --label io.ulpin.nonce=<nonce> --publish 127.0.0.1::5432 --tmpfs /var/lib/postgresql/data --env POSTGRES_USER=cr1_control --env POSTGRES_DB=cr1_<nonce> --env POSTGRES_PASSWORD <pinned PostGIS digest from compose.yaml>
runtimePlan.secrets: Fresh nonce-box secrets only, passed in process environment, never printed or recorded.
runtimePlan.cleanup: Verify nonce/task labels and remove only our two named containers; assert our nonce absent, not global container/volume/network equality.
